ladder.tooltip: Backoff ladder: consecutive failed half-open probes increase the break duration as base + increment x level (level capped at max count); it resets on recovery.

slowRate.tooltip: Slow demotion: this provider's recent generation rate stayed below its own baseline, so its routing priority is shifted down by this amount (demotion changes neither circuit breaking nor hedging). Each model of a provider is evaluated on its own; this shows the heaviest demotion and how many combinations qualify.

concurrency.tooltip: Live concurrency: the number of requests this provider is handling right now (each attempt of a hedge or retry counts once). Requires the global 'Live provider concurrency stats' switch, which refreshes every 5 seconds once enabled.
